scope: Native frontend document route rendering after asynchronous load; no backend changes.
defect: In a fresh zoneless browser the route document finished loading but the visible page retained its loading state. Popup input rendering was unaffected.
fix: Keep the existing route config in an Angular signal so async success and failure notify the rendered view.

addedChecks: Async success renders without user interaction
Async failure removes loading and renders unavailable state

performance: No query, polling, timer or extra request added. Rendering is notified once at each existing route-state transition. No matched performance run for this UI-only fix.
